official.deadline_central_display: Thursday, 3 December 2026 at 23:59 (11:59 PM) local Mexico City time; reception opened 23 February 2026 for the national and abroad tracks and 1 June 2026 for the consolidation track
official.deadline_note: Two Avisos (1 and 5 June 2026) adjusted the calendar for the Becas de Consolidacion track only; all tracks share the 3 December 2026 closing date. Days run 09:00-23:59 Mexico City time.
official.status_note: The official page displays 'Estatus de la convocatoria: Abierta' with reception of applications running to 3 December 2026; results are published by bimestre, with the first results list dated 31 July 2026 and the 'Segundo Bimestre' list dated 30 September 2026.
benefits: One-off payment of MXN 43,876.35 ('recibira un pago unico de $43,876.35 MXN') for the care and attention of children
Paid in a single exhibition ('El apoyo complementario se pagara en una sola exhibicion')
Assigned per daughter or son, to the mother and father where both are scholarship holders
eligibility: Hold a current SECIHTI beca de posgrado nacional, abroad (en el extranjero) or de consolidacion
Have had, adopted or had recognised by final judgment a daughter or son born between 1 December 2025 and 30 November 2026

Restrictions: no applications are processed from persons with a report of non-compliance or arrears under programme S190, persons with an equivalent state support for the same purpose, or persons presenting false information or documents
requirements: Create, update or validate your CV in the Perfil Unico (rizoma.conahcyt.mx)
Register and submit the complementary support application per the published Guia de Postulacion for your track
Sign the application electronically with your CURP (Clave Unica de Registro de Poblacion)
Follow the application in the Apeiron system (apeiron.secihti.mx) and correct any notified inconsistency within 5 business days
Register a bank account in the beneficiary's own name before formalisation, and sign the CAB (Convenio de Asignacion de Beca o Apoyo) and Anexo Uno
documents: Certified copy of the birth or adoption certificate issued by the Registro Civil for each child born, adopted or recognised between 1 December 2025 and 30 November 2026, showing the scholar parent's name
Certified copy of the foreign birth registration before a Mexican consular office abroad for each child born in that window
Where applicable, the final judgment decreeing guardianship (sentencia definitiva que decreta la tutoria)
selection_criteria: Applications presented in time and form that meet the documentation and requirements of the convocatoria and budget availability
Inconsistencies are notified once through Apeiron; failure to correct within 5 business days means the application is dismissed
coverage: Rubro covered by the support: 'pago unico de $43,876.35 MXN' for the care and attention of children
Paid in a single exhibition; payment within 20 business days of formalisation (December and January payments subject to SHCP spending rules)
application_method: Create or update your CV in the Perfil Unico at rizoma.conahcyt.mx
Register and submit the application through the SECIHTI BECAS platform per the Guia de Postulacion for your track
Sign electronically with your CURP and track the file in Apeiron
Formalise via the CAB and Anexo Uno with a registered bank account in your own name
official.application_route: Online via the SECIHTI BECAS platform with a Perfil Unico CV and CURP electronic signature, following the published postulacion guide for your track.
official.citizenship_residency: For beneficiaries of SECIHTI scholarships - Mexican nationals holding a beca de posgrado nacional, abroad, or de consolidacion.
official.international_eligibility: Indirectly - the abroad track (en el extranjero) covers Mexican nationals already studying outside Mexico on a SECIHTI scholarship.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Requires an active SECIHTI beca de posgrado nacional (national or abroad track) or a SECIHTI beca de consolidacion (consolidation track).
official.duration: One-off support; results and follow-up are published by bimestre (two-month periods), with results lists dated 31 July 2026 and 30 September 2026 ('Segundo Bimestre').
official.description: The SECIHTI 2026 convocatoria for the Apoyo Complementario de Maternidad y Paternidad (national, abroad and consolidation) calls beneficiaries of SECIHTI postgraduate scholarships who had, adopted or recognised a child between 1 December 2025 and 30 November 2026 to apply for a one-off complementary payment of MXN 43,876.35 for childcare.

not_confirmed: tuition_coverage - the scheme is a one-off childcare top-up, not a study-cost scholarship
verification.notes: Read the official convocatoria page (period 2026, status 'Abierta', publication 23 February 2026, reception 23 February - 3 December 2026 23:59 CDMX, results by bimestre, two Avisos for the consolidacion track) and downloaded and text-extracted the official convocatoria PDF from the SECIHTI domain, which carries the amount (pago unico de $43,876.35 MXN), eligibility window (children born/adopted/recognised 1 December 2025 - 30 November 2026), documentation, restrictions, selection, formalisation and payment terms. Note the payment is a single exhibition; the bimestre cadence applies to results publication, not instalments.

applicant_utility.summary: If you already hold a SECIHTI postgraduate or consolidation scholarship and your child was born, adopted or recognised between 1 December 2025 and 30 November 2026, this is a one-off MXN 43,876.35 top-up paid in a single exhibition - not a monthly scheme, and not a study scholarship - and the window stays open until 3 December 2026 at 23:59 Mexico City time. The application only works if your Perfil Unico CV is current, because you must attach to it, sign with your CURP and then chase any inconsistency inside Apeiron within five business days or the file is dismissed. Payment only starts after you formalise the CAB and Anexo Uno with a bank account in your own name, and it lands within 20 business days - except for December and January, which follow Hacienda's spending rules, so a late-2026 formalisation can mean a slower transfer.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Current SECIHTI postgraduate or consolidation scholarship holders (in Mexico or abroad) who became parents between December 2025 and November 2026.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your child's date of birth, adoption or recognition falls between 1 December 2025 and 30 November 2026 - outside that window the application does not qualify
Update or validate your CV in the Perfil Unico at rizoma.conahcyt.mx before starting
Obtain the certified Registro Civil birth/adoption certificate, the certified consular foreign-birth registration, or the guardianship judgment, showing the scholar parent's name
File through the SECIHTI BECAS platform per your track's Guia de Postulacion and sign electronically with your CURP
Monitor Apeiron daily: you get one five-business-day chance to fix any notified inconsistency
Register your bank account in your own name and sign the CAB and Anexo Uno promptly - payment follows formalisation
common_rejection_risks: Children born outside the 1 December 2025 - 30 November 2026 window
Any non-compliance report or arrears under the S190 programme, which bars processing
Receiving an equivalent state support for the same purpose - an explicit incompatibility
Letting the five-business-day inconsistency window lapse
Missing bank-account registration or CAB signature, which leaves the support unformalised and unpaid
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: This is a single MXN 43,876.35 payment for childcare - it does not replace your scholarship, and any costs beyond childcare (tuition, living, travel) remain covered only by your underlying beca.
document_audit: The birth or adoption certificate must be a certified copy from the Registro Civil and must show the scholar parent's name
Children born abroad need the certified registration before a Mexican consular office, not a local foreign certificate
Guardianship cases need the final judgment decreeing tutela
If both parents hold SECIHTI scholarships the support is assigned per child to each of them - check your household situation fits the per-child rule
alerts: The closing date is 3 December 2026 at 23:59 Mexico City time; days run 09:00-23:59 CDMX
December and January payments are subject to Hacienda spending rules, so formalise as early as possible
Results are published by bimestre (31 July 2026 and 30 September 2026 lists already out), so later bimestres can still deliver outcomes after the call closes
The two June 2026 Avisos moved the calendar for the consolidacion track only - confirm which calendar governs you
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Perfil Unico CV, then the BECAS-platform application signed with your CURP, one inconsistency-correction round in Apeiron, results by bimestre, then CAB/Anexo Uno formalisation with a registered bank account and payment within 20 business days.
